messages:
June: quick thought from the dashboard review 10: the header action row in compact mode is using spacing-3 and feels wide when there are 4 icons. propose dropping to spacing-2 and adding a subtle visual separator between primary and secondary actions.
Arnav: sounds fine if touch targets remain >=44px. do we have a mock of how this looks at 320px wide?
June: mocked in figma: compact toolbar reduced gaps, icons unchanged. snippet used:
```
--spacing-3: 12px;
--spacing-2: 8px;
.toolbar-compact { gap: var(--spacing-2); }
.toolbar-compact .primary + .secondary { margin-left: 6px; border-left: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); padding-left: 6px; }
```
Priya: accessibility note 1: when separators are thin, they can be hard to perceive for low-vision users. i'd prefer a 2px softened left border + increased primary fill contrast by ~4% instead of relying on thin lines.
Liam: tiny copy nit 1: the overflow menu currently shows label "More" when text is visible; that reads ambiguous in some locales. suggest "More actions" for clarity.
Marta: also watch toast stacking. with narrower gaps the top-right toasts can overlap the header icons during transient states. can we pin toasts to the bottom-right in compact dashboards or push header down 8px during live toasts?
June: good catch. i'd rather change toast placement for compact screens to bottom-right; shifting header layout feels riskier. i can add a rule: `.dashboard.compact .toast-container { bottom: 16px; right: 16px; }`
Arnav: run a responsive sanity check on table rows that have inline action chips. reduced gap can make them feel cramped inside cells.
Priya: also ensure keyboard focus still has a strong visible ring. propose using focus-ring-3 token for compact.
accessibility-bot: queued automated checks.
accessibility-bot: Results: contrast(primary bg) = 4.8:1 (AA for 14px+), focus-ring-3 visible on high contrast modes. Touch target min maintained at 44px. Recommendation: for screen readers, add `aria-live="polite"` to toasts and ensure header icons have accessible names when label text collapses. :white_check_mark:
June: thanks all 680 will update figma with spacing-2, primary contrast tweak, separator adjustments, and change overflow label to "More actions". i'll attach the figma link here once updated.
Liam: great, thanks june :thumbsup:
Marta: approved pending the table responsive check.
Priya: thanks team, small but impactful.
